description: This file defines the class ScrollViewAsMainChild, a custom ScrollView implementation that manages a list of items with special scrolling behavior, including visibility and scaling adjustments for remote views within a LinearLayout container.

classes.name: ScrollViewAsMainChild
classes.description: A custom ScrollView that manages a list of child views with special scrolling and visibility behavior, including scaling and offset adjustments.

methods.name: ScrollViewAsMainChild
methods.description: Constructors initializing the custom scroll view with various parameter sets.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view by inflating the internal layout.

methods.name: onFinishInflate
methods.description: Called after the view and all its children have been inflated; sets up references and scroll listener.

methods.name: onScrollChanged
methods.description: Handles scroll events to adjust visibility and scale of child views based on scroll position.

methods.name: addListItem
methods.description: Adds a new view to the list of items.

methods.name: removeAllListItems
methods.description: Removes all list items except the bottom gap view.

methods.name: setBottomOffset
methods.description: Sets the bottom offset by adjusting the height of the bottom gap view.

methods.name: getItemsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of list items.
